annotations.title: Find SDSs for an inventory list

description: Look up the manufacturer safety data sheet (SDS) for a LIST of workplace chemicals or products at once, e.g. the product-name column of a chemical inventory spreadsheet. Returns one row per product: whether a verified SDS PDF was found, the manufacturer, and the PDF link, using the same rules as find_safety_data_sheet (an unidentifiable product is reported as not found, never guessed). Up to 10 products per call; call again for the rest. Free, no signup. Use it when someone has several chemicals or an SDS binder/inventory to fill in.

products.description: Chemical or product names, one per item (max 10 per call; extra items are listed as not looked up).

name: find_sds_for_inventory
title: Find safety data sheets for a chemical inventory list (batch)
